products.title: Dr. Althea 345 Relief Serum
products.body_html:
Give your skin daily comfort and hydration with Dr. Althea 345 Relief Serum, a lightweight soothing serum specially formulated to calm visible irritation, replenish moisture, and support a healthy-looking skin barrier ✨🌿
Its gentle, fast-absorbing formula is ideal for sensitive and acne-prone skin, helping the complexion feel balanced, refreshed, and comfortable without any sticky residue.

Powered by a nourishing blend of Birch Sap, Tea Tree Leaf Water, Panthenol, Niacinamide, PDRN, and Ceramide NP, this hydrating facial serum helps strengthen the skin’s moisture barrier while providing long-lasting hydration. It also helps improve the appearance of stressed and dehydrated skin, leaving it feeling smoother, softer, and more resilient 💧

Perfect for both morning and evening routines, this daily calming serum helps maintain healthy-looking, well-balanced skin with every use 🌸

✨ Features

  • 🌿 Helps calm the appearance of visible irritation
  • 💧 Provides deep and long-lasting hydration
  • ✨ Supports and strengthens the skin barrier
  • 🌸 Formulated with Birch Sap, Tea Tree Leaf Water, and Panthenol
  • 🧴 Contains Niacinamide, PDRN, and Ceramide NP for skin care support
  • 🚿 Fast-absorbing, lightweight, non-sticky texture
  • 👌 Suitable for sensitive and acne-prone skin

🌟 Benefits

  • Helps improve skin comfort and balance
  • Supports a smoother and healthier-looking complexion
  • Assists in maintaining hydration throughout the day
  • Helps improve the appearance of stressed and dehydrated skin
  • Leaves the skin feeling soft, refreshed, and resilient

📌 How to Use:

  1. Cleanse your skin and apply toner
  2. Apply an appropriate amount of serum to the face
  3. Gently pat until fully absorbed
  4. Follow with your favorite moisturizer
  5. Use morning and evening as part of your daily skincare routine

products.title: Dr. Althea - Retinol Flat Iron Eye Roller - 25ml
products.body_html:
Revitalize the delicate eye area with Dr. Althea Retinol Flat Iron Eye Roller, an advanced eye serum featuring a cooling metal roller applicator for targeted care and a refreshing massage experience ✨👁️
Specially designed for concerns such as fine lines, puffiness, and loss of elasticity, this eye treatment helps leave the under-eye area looking smoother, firmer, and more refreshed.

Formulated with Retinol, Bakuchiol, Hyaluronic Acid, and soothing Cica ingredients, this anti-aging eye serum helps hydrate and improve the appearance of wrinkles while supporting a more youthful-looking eye contour. The cooling roller applicator gently massages the skin, helping the eye area feel refreshed and revitalized with every use 💧

Its lightweight texture absorbs easily, making it an excellent addition to your evening skincare routine for a brighter and healthier-looking appearance 🌸

✨ Features

  • 👁️ Helps improve the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles
  • 💧 Provides hydration and supports smoother-looking skin
  • ✨ Helps improve the appearance of skin elasticity around the eyes
  • 🌿 Contains Retinol, Bakuchiol, Hyaluronic Acid, and Cica
  • ❄️ Cooling metal roller applicator for a refreshing massage effect
  • 🌸 Helps reduce the appearance of tired-looking eyes and puffiness

📌 How to Use:

  • Press gently to dispense a small amount of serum
  • Roll around the eye area using the metal applicator
  • Gently massage until fully absorbed
  • Start gradually, preferably during your evening skincare routine
  • Apply sunscreen the following morning

⚠️ Caution:

  • For external use only
  • Avoid direct contact with the eyes
  • Do not use on irritated or damaged skin
  • Avoid combining with strong exfoliating acids in the same routine unless advised by a skincare professional
  • Retinol may initially cause dryness or irritation
  • Discontinue use if severe redness, peeling, or burning occurs
  • Retinol products are generally not recommended during pregnancy or breastfeeding unless approved by a doctor

products.title: Dr. Melaxin Calcium Bonding Serum (80ml)
products.body_html:
Enhance your skincare routine with Dr.Melaxin Calcium Bonding Serum, a facial serum specially formulated to support the appearance of firmer, smoother, and more youthful-looking skin ✨🌿
Its advanced formula combines calcium-based skincare technology with moisturizing and skin-conditioning ingredients to help improve the appearance of dry, tired, and less firm skin.

This firming facial serum delivers deep hydration while helping the skin appear more elastic, plump, and refreshed. With regular use, it helps improve overall skin texture and leaves the complexion looking smoother, healthier, and naturally radiant 💧

Its lightweight texture absorbs comfortably into the skin, making it suitable for both morning and evening skincare routines 🌸

✨ Features

  • 🌿 Helps improve the appearance of skin firmness and elasticity
  • 💧 Provides deep hydration and lasting comfort
  • ✨ Supports a smoother and plumper-looking complexion
  • 🌸 Helps revitalize dry and tired-looking skin
  • 🧴 Lightweight texture with quick absorption
  • 👌 Suitable for daily morning and evening use

📌 How to Use:

  • After cleansing and applying toner, apply an appropriate amount to the face
  • Gently spread and massage until fully absorbed
  • Follow with a moisturizer or cream to lock in hydration
  • Use morning and evening if well tolerated by the skin

⚠️ Caution:

  • For external use only
  • Perform a patch test before first use
  • Avoid direct contact with the eyes
  • Do not use on damaged or irritated skin
  • Discontinue use if redness, burning, tightness, or irritation occurs
  • Apply sunscreen during daytime use
